doc: The knowledge file in YAML, with CRLF endings, a comment and a key the designer does not model: a save without change, a cell's value, a new cell, an option removed with the cell and the filter condition that name it, and a new property; then undo back to the input.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A cell's text is replaced in place; a plain scalar stays plain.
steps.expect:
knowledge: "0.1"
# Cities of the Low Countries, kept by hand and by ADP.
name: Cities
activeView: v1
properties:
  - id: p1
    name: Name
    type: text
    title: true
  - id: p2
    name: Country
    type: selection
    options:
      - id: o1
        name: Netherlands
        colour: blue
      - id: o2
        name: Belgium
        colour: yellow
  - id: p3
    name: Population
    type: number
views:
  - id: v1
    name: All cities
    columns:
      - property: p3
        width: 120
    sorts:
      - property: p3
        direction: descending
    filter:
      - property: p2
        operator: is
        option: o2
    groupBy: p2
rows:
  - id: r1
    cells:
      - property: p1
        text: Amsterdam
      - property: p2
        option: o1
      - property: p3
        number: 931298
    source: census 2024   # not modelled, kept
  - id: r2
    cells:
      - property: p1
        text: Antwerpen
      - property: p2
        option: o2

steps.doc: A new cell goes after the row's last cell, indented like its siblings, with the rule's key order and the file's CRLF.
